name: El País
body: Pages declare their regional language, like es-CO, and carry rich JSON-LD. But the pages analyzed send no HSTS, no content security policy, no X-Frame-Options, and no nosniff, and http moves to https with a 302.
lesson: Start with four headers: Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, frame-ancestors, and a report-only CSP.
summary: elpais.com scores 74 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 20 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: 7 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 7 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: Claude-SearchBot (Claude search) by Disallow: /, Claude-User (Claude, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, PerplexityBot (Perplexity answers) by Disallow: /, Perplexity-User (Perplexity, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /,…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 3 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: arc-geo, eptz, hpage. Set on /america-colombia/, /america/, /mexico/ and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
The TLS certificate is valid for 42 more days
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 283 ms
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
